loyaltyRules.metaDescription: How the aimenu.ge loyalty program works — points, tiers, and discounts across every partner restaurant.
loyaltyRules.title: Eat more, save more.
loyaltyRules.lead: Every paid order on aimenu.ge earns points. The more you build up, the bigger the discount you carry into every participating restaurant.
loyaltyRules.step1Body: Any paid order — QR dine-in or pre-order — earns you 1 point plus 10% of the order total.
loyaltyRules.step2Body: Cross a threshold and you move up a tier. Points don't expire instantly — there's a rolling 12-month window.
loyaltyRules.step3Body: Your tier's discount is applied automatically at checkout at every participating restaurant.
loyaltyRules.tiersIntro: Four tiers, each with its own discount. Counting starts on your very first order.
loyaltyRules.tiersNote: Tier transitions happen automatically. The discount is applied at the bottom of every order.
loyaltyRules.earningIntro: Every paid order gives you two kinds of points at once:
loyaltyRules.earningRule1: 1 point per order — credit for showing up.
loyaltyRules.earningRule2: Plus 10% of the order total as bonus points — a 25 ₾ order = 2.5 points.
loyaltyRules.earningRule3: Points are valid for 12 months — consistent ordering protects your tier.
loyaltyRules.earningNote: Anonymous / phone-only orders don't earn points — sign in to make sure every visit counts.
loyaltyRules.restaurantOptInBody: The program is opt-in. Restaurants that join credit points to their guests and honour the tier discount.
loyaltyRules.restaurantOptInNote: Look for the star badge on restaurant cards — that marks a participating venue.
loyaltyRules.fineprint1: Points can't be transferred between accounts or converted to cash.
loyaltyRules.fineprint2: The discount is applied to the cart subtotal before taxes and fees.
loyaltyRules.fineprint3: If an order is cancelled, the corresponding points are reversed.
loyaltyRules.fineprint4: Tier thresholds and discount rates may be adjusted — your profile always reflects the current rules.

legal.privacyIntro: This page explains what aimenu.ge collects, why, and what choices you have.
legal.privacyDataBody:
Account info: name, email, phone, password (hashed). Cart and table session, stored in your browser. Bookings, orders, and payment status (we never see your card number — that lives with Bank of Georgia).

If you allow analytics cookies, Microsoft Clarity stores anonymous interaction data (clicks, scroll, page paths) for us.
legal.privacyUseBody: To run the service: show menus, take reservations, route orders to restaurants, send confirmations. Aggregated, non-identifying analytics help us prioritise UX work.
legal.privacyShareBody: Restaurant partners see only the orders and bookings made for them. Bank of Georgia processes card payments under their own privacy policy. We don't sell or rent personal data.
legal.privacyRightsBody: You can access, export, or delete your account data at any time from /profile/settings, or by emailing us. EU/UK visitors: GDPR rights apply (rectification, restriction, portability, complaint to a supervisory authority).
legal.privacyContactBody: Email info@telos.ge. We aim to reply within 14 days.
legal.termsIntro: By using aimenu.ge you agree to the terms set out below. Please read them carefully before using the service.
legal.termsGeneralBody:
This document is a legally binding agreement between the user and Telos LLC (identification number 405735879).

By using the platform, the user confirms they have fully read and agree to these terms.
legal.termsServiceBody:
aimenu.ge is an online platform that lets users search for and reserve tables at restaurants, browse menus and prices, place pre-orders and payments, and receive booking confirmations by email or SMS.

The platform acts as a technological intermediary between the user and partner restaurants and is not responsible for the service delivered by the restaurant.
legal.termsAccountBody:
When making a reservation or placing an order, the user is required to provide accurate and up-to-date information.

In the event of improper or abusive use, the user's access to the service may be suspended.
legal.termsOrdersBody:
All menu orders require advance payment. Payments are processed through secure providers (Bank of Georgia, Flitt); the platform does not store card data.

When a menu order is placed, the amount is temporarily held by the payment provider and is captured only after the order is confirmed, or released if the booking is not confirmed.

An order or reservation is considered confirmed when the platform displays the final booking page with the corresponding status, or when the user receives an official notification confirming the order.
legal.termsRefundsBody:
Reservations can be cancelled only through the platform, under the following conditions:

• Cancellation 24 or more hours before the reservation: 95% of the paid amount is refunded.

• Cancellation 4 or more hours before the reservation: 80% of the paid amount is refunded.

• Cancellation less than 4 hours before the reservation: no refund.

The cancellation date and time is the moment the user officially notifies the platform of the cancellation.

The user agrees that, when cancelling less than 4 hours before the reservation, the paid amount will not be refunded, and confirms they were informed of this condition in advance — they may not raise any claim against the platform in connection with non-refund, even if the restaurant fails to perform the service fully or partially. The platform is only a technological intermediary and is not liable for the restaurant's performance.
legal.termsExtraBody:
Refunds are issued using the same payment method used for the booking.

The platform is not liable where cancellation or refund could not be completed due to the user's own fault.

The cancellation date and time are determined by the time recorded in the system.
legal.termsLiabilityBody:
The platform is not responsible for the quality or performance of the service, except where the defect is caused by the platform's own fault.

If the user is late or fails to arrive, no refund is issued.
legal.termsDataBody:
User data is processed in accordance with the laws of Georgia.

Data is used solely for providing the service, communication, and improving the platform.

The user agrees that the platform may send informational messages, advertisements, and special offers via SMS or other communication channels.

Details are available on the Privacy Policy page.
legal.termsLawBody: These terms are governed by the laws of Georgia. Any dispute arising in connection with this agreement shall be resolved by the competent courts of Georgia.
